issues.detail: The Greek verb 'χαρισθησομαι' (future passive of χαρίζομαι) means 'I will be granted/given as a favor' (i.e., restored/released to you), not 'I will be forgiven' (tha thứ). The Vietnamese adds 'tha thứ' (forgiven), which introduces a concept not present in the Greek and changes the meaning from being granted/restored to being forgiven.
